rows: adm_0_name = 'SRI LANKA', T_res = 'Week', S_res = 'Admin0' (national weekly dengue case totals, weeks starting on Sunday).
whatThisTests: The MediSync detector and projection algorithms on public aggregate counts. These are not MediSync consultations, so this tests the algorithms, not the platform.

gaps.rule: Build a weekly grid from the first to the last reported week. A run of at most maxImputedWeeks missing weeks is filled by linear interpolation between its neighbours, rounded to whole cases. A longer run splits the series into separate segments.
gaps.note: Imputed weeks are used only as model input. They are never a detector target, a reference label, or a projection target.

referenceOutbreakRule.written: Before the detector or projection was run on these data.
referenceOutbreakRule.epidemicWeek: An observed week is an epidemic week when its count exceeds mean + thresholdSd x standard deviation of the observed counts in the same week of year (plus or minus seasonalWindowWeeks) in every OTHER year of the same segment.
referenceOutbreakRule.weekOfYear: ISO week number of the Monday that follows the reported week start.
referenceOutbreakRule.outbreakPeriod: A run of at least minConsecutiveWeeks consecutive observed epidemic weeks.
referenceOutbreakRule.note: This is a retrospective, seasonal 'endemic channel' style definition. It is independent of the detector, which compares against the previous 56 units only.

detector.function: evaluateOutbreakCriteria in server/src/services/surveillanceService.js, called unchanged through a Node bridge, level 'island'.
detector.unitSubstitution: One weekly count is fed to the detector as one detector 'day'. The detector then compares a 7-week window with the previous 56 weeks. The detector was designed for daily counts per district, so this is a change of time scale.
detector.evaluatedWeek: Week t is evaluated when the 63 weeks t-62..t are all in the same segment. The flag for week t is the detector's 'triggered' result with week t as the last window unit.
detector.eventMatch: A reference outbreak period counts as detected when a flag falls in the weeks from its start minus earlyWeeks to its end.
detector.falseAlarmEpisode: A run of consecutive flagged weeks that overlaps no reference outbreak period (with the same early allowance).

projection.function: calculate14DayForecast in server/src/utils/outbreakForecasting.js, called unchanged through the Node bridge with forecastDays = 4.
projection.unitSubstitution: One weekly count is one input point; forecast step k is week t+k.
projection.origin: Every week t where the 14 training weeks and the target week t+h are in the same segment, and t+h is observed (not imputed).

baselines.seasonalNaive: The count of week t+h-52 (same week one year earlier), when it lies in the same segment; otherwise the origin is left out for all methods at that horizon.

projection.metrics: Mean absolute error per horizon for each method, and the share of targets inside the projection's 95% interval (lower <= actual <= upper).
projection.uncertainty: Moving-block bootstrap over origins (block length blockWeeks, 2,000 resamples, fixed seed) for each MAE and for the paired MAE difference against each baseline.
